title: BrandConfig
description: Per-tenant settings for the white-label player. Copy brands/default.json, edit this shape, and open the player with ?brand=<file name>.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema so editors can validate the brand file.

brandId.description: Tenant id. Use the same value as the JSON file name when selecting the brand with ?brand=.

name.description: Brand name shown in the page heading and document title.

backgroundColor.description: Page background. Any CSS color is accepted.

accentColor.description: Control color, used by the play button.

accentTextColor.description: Text color drawn on top of accentColor.

easeLive.description: Ease Live Studio program for this tenant.

projectId.description: Optional. Ease Live infers the project from programId when this is omitted.

env.description: Ease Live environment. Defaults to prod.

streamUrl.description: Per-tenant backend stream URL. Point this at the brand's HLS or DASH playback endpoint.
